title: Method of Fundamental Solutions for Maxwell's Equations in Bi-Periodic Multilayered Media
summary: In this paper, we present an accurate numerical method for the time-harmonic Maxwell's equations for bi-periodic multilayered media with quasi-periodic incident waves using the Method of Fundamental Solutions in conjunction with a periodization scheme. Following an approach used in acoustic scattering problems, the electric and magnetic fields in each layer are expressed as a sum of near and distant interactions.
